style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=-4;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=none;whiteSpace=wrap;fontFamily=Helvetica;" value="<div><b>Inbound — Employees &rarr; ALBs</b></div><div><span style="color: light-dark(rgb(0,0,0), rgb(255,255,255));">Browser &rarr; Internet Gateway &rarr; internal ALB (HTTP :80). Open WebUI ALB routes to pod :3000; Grafana/ArgoCD ALB routes to monitoring/gitops pods.</span></div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="490" x="2692" y="200" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="leg-badge-2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#007CBD;strokeColor=default;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=22;labelBackgroundColor=none;fontFamily=Helvetica;shadow=1;glass=0;strokeWidth=2;" value="2" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="40" x="2640" y="308" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="leg-desc-2" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=-4;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=none;whiteSpace=wrap;fontFamily=Helvetica;" value="<div><b>ALB &rarr; Open WebUI Pod (:3000)</b></div><div><span style="color: light-dark(rgb(0,0,0), rgb(255,255,255));">ALB terminates HTTP and forwards to the Open WebUI StatefulSet in the private subnet. Open WebUI is the employee-facing chat UI.</span></div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="490" x="2692" y="308" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="leg-badge-3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#007CBD;strokeColor=default;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=22;labelBackgroundColor=none;fontFamily=Helvetica;shadow=1;glass=0;strokeWidth=2;" value="3" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="40" x="2640" y="416" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="leg-desc-3" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=-4;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=none;whiteSpace=wrap;fontFamily=Helvetica;" value="<div><b>Open WebUI &rarr; LiteLLM Proxy (:4000)</b></div><div><span style="color: light-dark(rgb(0,0,0), rgb(255,255,255));">Open WebUI sends POST /api/chat/completions to the LiteLLM internal ALB. LiteLLM speaks the OpenAI API format — Open WebUI treats it as an OpenAI endpoint.</span></div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="490" x="2692" y="416" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="leg-badge-4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#007CBD;strokeColor=default;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=22;labelBackgroundColor=none;fontFamily=Helvetica;shadow=1;glass=0;strokeWidth=2;" value="4" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="40" x="2640" y="524" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="leg-desc-4" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=-4;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=none;whiteSpace=wrap;fontFamily=Helvetica;" value="<div><b>LiteLLM &rarr; Redis (:6379) — Cache</b></div><div><span style="color: light-dark(rgb(0,0,0), rgb(255,255,255));">Before calling any LLM provider, LiteLLM checks Redis for a cached response (TTL 1h). Cache hits avoid API costs. Also used for rate-limit counters per user/team.</span></div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="490" x="2692" y="524" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="leg-badge-5" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#007CBD;strokeColor=default;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=22;labelBackgroundColor=none;fontFamily=Helvetica;shadow=1;glass=0;strokeWidth=2;" value="5" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="40" x="2640" y="632" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="leg-desc-5" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=-4;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=none;whiteSpace=wrap;fontFamily=Helvetica;" value="<div><b>LiteLLM &rarr; PostgreSQL (:5432) — Budget</b></div><div><span style="color: light-dark(rgb(0,0,0), rgb(255,255,255));">LiteLLM validates virtual keys, checks monthly team budgets, and records per-request spend. PostgreSQL holds all LiteLLM operational state (teams, keys, budgets).</span></div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="490" x="2692" y="632" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="leg-badge-6" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#007CBD;strokeColor=default;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=22;labelBackgroundColor=none;fontFamily=Helvetica;shadow=1;glass=0;strokeWidth=2;" value="6" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="40" x="2640" y="740" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="leg-desc-6" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=-4;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=none;whiteSpace=wrap;fontFamily=Helvetica;" value="<div><b>LiteLLM &rarr; Ollama (:11434) — Private Chat</b></div><div><span style="color: light-dark(rgb(0,0,0), rgb(255,255,255));">Requests using the private-chat alias route to Ollama (llama3.2, 3B param). Prompts never leave the VPC. Model weights stored on a 50Gi gp3 EBS PVC.</span></div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="490" x="2692" y="740" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="leg-badge-7" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#007CBD;strokeColor=default;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=22;labelBackgroundColor=none;fontFamily=Helvetica;shadow=1;glass=0;strokeWidth=2;" value="7" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="40" x="2640" y="848" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="leg-desc-7" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=-4;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=none;whiteSpace=wrap;fontFamily=Helvetica;" value="<div><b>LiteLLM &rarr; NAT GW &rarr; LLM Providers (HTTPS :443)</b></div><div><span style="color: light-dark(rgb(0,0,0), rgb(255,255,255));">Outbound HTTPS via single NAT Gateway to OpenAI (gpt-4o/mini), Google Gemini (2.0-flash), Anthropic (claude-sonnet-4-6 via vip.digishop.work). Fallback chain: provider &rarr; claude-sonnet &rarr; private-chat.</span></div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="490" x="2692" y="848" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="leg-badge-8" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#007CBD;strokeColor=default;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=22;labelBackgroundColor=none;fontFamily=Helvetica;shadow=1;glass=0;strokeWidth=2;" value="8" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="40" x="2640" y="956" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="leg-desc-8" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=-4;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=none;whiteSpace=wrap;fontFamily=Helvetica;" value="<div><b>LiteLLM &rarr; Langfuse (:3000) — Traces</b></div><div><span style="color: light-dark(rgb(0,0,0), rgb(255,255,255));">Every request/response is sent async to Langfuse as a trace (user_id, model, tokens, cost, latency). Langfuse worker stores traces in ClickHouse for analytics queries.</span></div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="490" x="2692" y="956" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="leg-badge-9" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#007CBD;strokeColor=default;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=22;labelBackgroundColor=none;fontFamily=Helvetica;shadow=1;glass=0;strokeWidth=2;" value="9" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="40" x="2640" y="1064" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="leg-desc-9" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=-4;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=none;whiteSpace=wrap;fontFamily=Helvetica;" value="<div><b>Prometheus scrapes metrics every 30s</b></div><div><span style="color: light-dark(rgb(0,0,0), rgb(255,255,255));">LiteLLM :4000/metrics (request rate, error rate, cost, latency), Redis :9121 (redis_exporter), PostgreSQL :9187 (postgres_exporter), Open WebUI :8080. ServiceMonitor resources wire these scrape targets.</span></div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="490" x="2692" y="1064" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="leg-badge-10" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#007CBD;strokeColor=default;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=22;labelBackgroundColor=none;fontFamily=Helvetica;shadow=1;glass=0;strokeWidth=2;" value="10" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="40" x="2640" y="1172" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="leg-desc-10" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=-4;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=none;whiteSpace=wrap;fontFamily=Helvetica;" value="<div><b>Promtail &rarr; Loki (:3100) — Log shipping</b></div><div><span style="color: light-dark(rgb(0,0,0), rgb(255,255,255));">Promtail DaemonSet (1 pod/node) reads /var/log/pods/* and pushes structured log lines to the Loki nginx gateway.
